manage.title: Manage LDAP directories
manage.description: Add, change and remove the LDAP directories people can sign in with.

providers.deleteConfirm: Delete this directory? Its users will not be able to sign in with it.
providers.name: Display Name
providers.enabledDesc: Let users sign in with this directory.
providers.dialogDesc: Connect an LDAP or Active Directory server so users can sign in with it.

fields.useTlsDesc: Connect over an encrypted LDAPS connection.
fields.tlsSkipVerifyDesc: Accept any certificate the server shows. Only use this for a test directory, since anyone in between could read the passwords.
fields.tlsCaCertDesc: Paste the PEM certificate that signed your directory's certificate if it is not from a public CA.
fields.secretKeep: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
fields.defaultRolesDesc: Termix roles every user from this directory gets when they sign in. Separate names with commas.
fields.roleMapDesc: One group:role per line. The group can be its cn or full DN. Users get the role at sign in while they are in the group, and lose it once they leave. Needs a group search base.

plugin.name: LDAP
plugin.description: Sign in with your LDAP or Active Directory username and password.
